contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, early medieval, pierced, silver coin of Cnut (1016-1035). Short cross type dating c.1029-1035/6. Moneyer: Hildulf of York. Pierced hole for suspension to right of bust. North 1994, p.168 no. 790-1. Obverse inscription: [CNUT] RECX. Obverse description: Bust left, diademed, in-front sceptre with lis head. Reverse inscription: +HILDVLF ON EOF.
